scope: Planning only; one step within the existing first shot

source.line: Después del paso del maestro llegó una mujer que caminaba de noche.

action: Huitaca brings the originally trailing foot forward and completes one deliberate step.

frames.contact_evidence: A ahead, B trailing. Record the two original contact points.
frames.action_prompt: Use the original b1a photograph, unchanged.

frames.beat: Transfer weight onto A; B's heel rises slightly.
frames.contact_evidence: A remains planted. B's toe still touches the road.
frames.action_prompt: Transfer her weight onto foot A. Lift only the heel of trailing foot B a little, leaving its toes on the same road contact point. A stays planted.

frames.beat: B's toe releases from the road.
frames.contact_evidence: A supports the body; a visible gap appears under B.
frames.action_prompt: Lift the toes of trailing foot B off the road. A still carries her weight at the same contact point. A small visible gap must appear under B.

frames.beat: B's knee bends and begins the forward swing.
frames.contact_evidence: A stays planted. B is unmistakably airborne.
frames.action_prompt: Bend the knee of leg B and start swinging B forward, still behind the supporting leg. B is clearly airborne; A stays planted.

frames.beat: B moves forward toward the supporting leg.
frames.contact_evidence: A remains fixed; B has not yet passed A.
frames.action_prompt: Bring the raised foot B farther forward toward leg A, without yet passing A. Keep the supporting foot A fixed against the same stones.

frames.beat: B reaches the passing position under the pelvis.
frames.contact_evidence: B remains raised. Two legs remain distinguishable, with no fusion.
frames.action_prompt: Bring foot B into the passing position beneath her pelvis, beside the supporting leg. B stays above the road; both legs remain distinct.

frames.beat: B moves beyond A toward the camera.
frames.contact_evidence: B is visibly the forward-moving foot. A still supports.
frames.action_prompt: Advance the raised foot B beyond A toward the camera. B must now visibly pass the supporting foot in depth. A stays planted.

frames.beat: B's lower leg extends, heel approaching the path.
frames.contact_evidence: B has not landed yet. No skating of A.
frames.action_prompt: Extend the lower leg B forward and lower its heel toward the road, with its toes slightly raised. B has not touched down yet. A remains at its old contact.

frames.beat: B's heel makes the new contact ahead of A.
frames.contact_evidence: Brief double support; heel contact is visible.
frames.action_prompt: Place the heel of B on the road ahead of A. Keep its toes slightly lifted for this contact pose. This is brief double support; the forward foot has changed.

frames.beat: B's sole lowers to the road.
frames.contact_evidence: B is flat and ahead; A trails.
frames.action_prompt: Lower the sole of B fully onto the road ahead of A. A remains behind at its previous contact. B is now unmistakably the leading foot.

frames.beat: Weight moves onto B; A's heel begins to lift.
frames.contact_evidence: B's new contact stays fixed. A's toes still touch.
frames.action_prompt: Transfer her weight onto planted foot B. Raise the heel of trailing A slightly, keeping A toes in contact and the new B contact fixed.

frames.beat: Settle over B with a slight knee bend.
frames.contact_evidence: B is the stable leading foot; A trails. Continue walking after the shot, without starting a second swing here.
frames.action_prompt: Settle gently over foot B with a small bend of the supporting knee. A trails on its toes. Complete this single step without beginning a second leg swing.

review.on_failure: Retain rejected candidate; retry same exposure from latest accepted frame; never propagate the rejected image.

background_compositing.reason: Text constraints do not guarantee identical static pixels.
background_compositing.region: Fixed envelope containing both old/new silhouettes, required cloth movement and contact shadow
background_compositing.inside_region: Accepted edit; inspect restored road, seams, prior silhouette removal and shadows

diagram.view: side view only to explain contact mechanics; not the shot camera
